summary: EVAVO's governed review-first Growth/Business research Worker for bounded public-source opportunity intelligence, internal scoring, source/opportunity review, strategy memory and private operational reporting. Despite the historical generic repository name, it is not the generic agent execution fabric and grants no AI generation, outbound messaging, email, social posting, form submission, browser automation, external-state mutation, repository publication or deployment authority.

capabilities.title: Fetch bounded public research sources
capabilities.description: Perform explicitly authenticated, confirmation-gated, read-only public-source research with public-only URL policy, redirect revalidation, full-operation timeout, byte limits and SHA-256 evidence receipts.

capabilities.title: Manage internal research-source metadata
capabilities.description: Create and review bounded internal source candidates, health/cooldown metadata and research evidence in D1; changes remain internal and cannot trigger third-party mutation or outreach.

capabilities.title: Extract evidence-bounded opportunity candidates
capabilities.description: Deterministically extract and score opportunity candidates from admitted public evidence while preserving missing deadlines, values, currencies, eligibility and scope as unknown rather than guessing them.

capabilities.title: Calibrate review scoring from historical evidence
capabilities.description: Use existing review/source metadata to calibrate grounded internal evidence scoring without allowing historical learning to promote weak or missing evidence into high confidence.

capabilities.title: Produce private operational research reports
capabilities.description: Expose authenticated internal source, opportunity, strategy and audit reporting plus aggregate non-sensitive public status without exposing admin credentials or converting records into drafts or outbound actions.

capabilities.title: Run internal-only scheduled maintenance
capabilities.description: Synchronize defensive flags, refresh learning from existing D1 review metadata and record internal audit events; scheduled execution cannot fetch public sources, discover opportunities, generate drafts or perform external actions.

capabilities.title: Validate source-secret and request-boundary safety
capabilities.description: Scan tracked source for deployable credential patterns without printing matched secrets and validate media-type, byte, UTF-8, JSON structure, nesting, node, string/key and prototype-pollution request boundaries.

capabilities.title: Check required private repository posture
capabilities.description: Validate that the provider repository is private, unarchived and matches the expected EVAVO identity; the check is read-only and cannot itself change GitHub visibility.
requires: Separate GitHub administration authority for visibility changes
